<function name="GetLastSimulationTime" parent="physenv" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>
		Returns the last simulation duration of the in-game physics.
	</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<added>2023.01.25</added>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="number">The last simulation duration of the in-game physics in seconds</ret>
	</rets>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Prints a message when physics lag of over 100ms is detected</description>
	<code>hook.Add("Think", "LagDetector", function ()
	if physenv.GetLastSimulationTime() * 1000 > 100 then
		print("Physics lag detected!")
	end
end)</code>
</example>
